verdicts.name: Chicken breast
issues: Cooked half is acceptable (FNDDS baked/broiled/roasted 161/30.2/3.52) but not the tightest match: SR 171534 'Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, cooked, grilled' (151 kcal/30.54 P/3.17 F) is the direct cooked counterpart of the existing raw half 171077 (same SR item family, same skinless boneless breast), is plain (no added fat) and is grilled, which matches how the user actually cooks it. Swap for exact pair sameness.

Do NOT use FNDDS 'Chicken breast, grilled without sauce, skin not eaten' (2705968, 176/29.6/5.45): its numbers are identical to FNDDS 'Chicken breast, baked, coated, skin / coating not eaten' (2705981), i.e. the FNDDS grilled recipe carries added fat; it is not plain skinless breast.
Missing obvious aliases: 'skinless chicken breast', 'boneless skinless chicken breast', 'chicken breast grilled'.

cooked.description: Chicken, broiler or fryers, breast, skinless, boneless, meat only, cooked, grilled

verdicts.name: Rotisserie chicken, meat only
issues: Pairing is the best USDA offers: FNDDS rotisserie NS-as-to-part skin not eaten (164/26.8/6.36) vs SR whole broiler meat only raw (119/21.4/3.08). Same food class (whole bird, meat only). Rotisserie birds are brined so a true raw would be a few percent lower in kcal, but no USDA raw exists for that; nobody weighs rotisserie chicken raw anyway. Home 'roast chicken' skin not eaten (FNDDS 2705934, 165/27.3/5.32) is numerically the same, so the 'roast chicken'/'whole chicken' aliases are safe.

verdicts.name: Chicken liver
issues: Alias 'liver' hijacks any liver search (beef liver etc.). Keep the entry, drop the bare alias.

verdicts.name: Turkey breast, roasted
issues: Confirmed plain: SR 'Turkey, retail parts, breast, meat only, cooked, roasted' (136/29.51/1.97), not deli. Raw is the matching SR retail-parts breast. Cooked fat (1.97) is marginally below raw fat (2.33) which is an SR sampling artefact, well within tolerance.

verdicts.name: Ground turkey, 93/7
issues: Cooked fdcId 746785 returns 404 (usda_verified false). The correct SR record is 172851 'Turkey, ground, 93% lean, 7% fat, pan-broiled crumbles' 213 kcal/27.1 P/0 C/11.6 F (the stored 220 kcal was wrong). Raw 172850 is the same 93% lean SR item, so lean % matches after the fix.

cooked.description: Turkey, ground, 93% lean, 7% fat, pan-broiled crumbles

verdicts.name: Ground turkey, 85/15
issues: Both halves are SR 85% lean / 15% fat (174494 crumbles, 174493 raw). Same lean %.

verdicts.name: Duck breast, skin-on
issues: Raw half still not found: searched 'duck breast raw', 'duck white pekin breast', 'duckling breast meat and skin raw' and probed 4 neighbouring SR ids; the White Pekin breast meat-and-skin raw record does not surface through this endpoint. Leave raw null. Cooked SR roasted White Pekin breast meat and skin (202/24.5/10.8) is the right item; 'duck' alias landing on skin-on breast is what most people mean.

verdicts.name: Duck, skinless
issues: Cooked FNDDS 'Duck, roasted, skin not eaten' (200/23.4/11.15) matches SR 172411 'Duck, domesticated, meat only, cooked, roasted' (201/23.5/11.2) exactly, and the raw half is the SR partner of that. Fat roughly doubling raw to cooked is real for duck (skin fat renders into the meat).

summary: Checked all 19 POULTRY entries on name->item, pair sameness, numbers, aliases and default; 46 USDA requests used. Wrong: Ground turkey 93/7 cooked id 746785 is a 404 -> replace with SR 172851 (213 kcal, not 220). Chicken liver alias 'liver' hijacks -> drop it. Chicken breast: keep away from FNDDS 'grilled without sauce' (its numbers equal the 'baked, coated' recipe, so it carries added fat); the current baked/broiled/roasted item is fine, but SR 171534 skinless boneless breast cooked grilled (151/30.5/3.2) is the exact cooked partner of the existing raw 171077 and matches grilling, so I recommend swapping plus adding 'skinless chicken breast' aliases. Rotisserie pairing (brined FNDDS vs SR whole broiler meat only raw) is the best USDA offers and passes; ground turkey 85/15 halves are both 85% lean; turkey breast cooked is plain SR roasted retail-parts breast, not deli. Duck breast skin-on raw still not findable through this endpoint after 3 searches and id probing; leave null. Added 5 missing foods, all ids confirmed via ?fdc=: chicken thigh skin-on, chicken breast skin-on, ground turkey 99/1 (USDA 'fat free'), turkey thigh, rotisserie chicken breast.
